_comment: Batch-2 (docs/24) model-artifact fetch policy for the llama.cpp desktop installer — single source of truth. The installer pulls GGUF weights DIRECTLY from Hugging Face (a different path from today's shipped Ollama-guided install, which uses `ollama pull`). Language-neutral data: the Rust installer and the security tests both read it. NOT user-facing until the signed installer ships.

integrity.digest_status: measured per model at the release build and frozen alongside the registry; the installer refuses a file whose sha256 does not match. Not fabricated here.

retry.note: Partial downloads resume; a failed integrity check re-fetches; re-running the installer is safe (no duplicate or half-written state).
